speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific appearance of your longstanding rash and tell me if you have noticed any scaling, blistering, or color changes on your palms or soles.

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a chronic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy (tingling/numbness in palms), and environmental triggers (livestock/rice farm) strongly suggests PCT, often associated with iron overload or viral hepatitis. Have you noticed any blisters forming on your skin or dark urine?
